request.style: English, female voice solo, Celtic harp, bodhran, tin whistle, fiddle, mood solemn and majestic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A conspiracy formed in the city gate
Amaziah fled to Lachish in fear
They sent men after him to that place
Killing the king who had reigned so long

They brought him back on horses home
Buried in the City of David
Among his fathers in the sacred ground
The people gathered in the streets

[Pre-Chorus]
Took the young prince from the royal house
Sixteen years old upon the throne
In place of his father who is gone
Azariah rules the land of Judah

[Chorus]
His mother's name was Jecoliah
A woman of Jerusalem
She stood in the shadow of kings
Her name recorded in the chronicles

[Verse]
Uzziah was sixteen years old
When he became king in Jerusalem
He reigned fifty-two years there
Seeking the Lord with all his heart

He rebuilt Eloth for Judah
After the king rested with fathers
He did what was right in God's eyes
Just as his father Amaziah did

[Chorus]
His mother's name was Jecoliah
A woman of Jerusalem
She stood in the shadow of kings
Her name recorded in the chronicles

[Bridge]
He set himself to seek God
In the days of Zechariah's visions
As long as he sought the Lord
God gave him success and strength

[Outro]
Jecoliah of Jerusalem
Mother of the faithful king
Her name lives in the scripture
In the history of Judah
